_meta.description: Heart event #4 for npc_leera: The Fear

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Leera sits at The Overlook, unusually quiet]

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Oh. Hey, Jack. ...Pull up some grass.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Can I ask you something weird?

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: What happens when there's nothing left to explore?

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: When every ruin is mapped. Every zone charted.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: What am I then? Just some girl who used to go places?

options.text: There's always more to discover. The world is bigger than we know.
Maybe exploring isn't who you are. It's how you love the world.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: You're annoyingly wise sometimes, you know that?

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Thanks for sitting with me. I don't usually... sit.
